    level="1"
    right="Item 5"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Corpseward Pendant](/Equipment.aspx?ID=806)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Agents of Edgewatch</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Abjuration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=2" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #157: Devil at the Dreaming Palace](/Sources.aspx?ID=45) pg. 80, [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 153 <sup>1.1</sup>

**Price** 150 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn amulet

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This small pendant is usually shaped like a humanoid skull or small animal skull.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> Interact;  **Frequency** three times per day;   **Effect** You become undetectable to [undead](/Traits.aspx?ID=160) creatures for 10 minutes. Undead can't see, hear, or smell you, nor detect you with sensory capabilities such as [scent](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=33) or [tremorsense](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=40). A creature can attempt a single DC 18 Will saving throw to ignore this effect. If an undead has reason to believe that undetected opponents are present, it can still attempt to [Seek](/Actions.aspx?ID=84) or Strike you. If you attempt to use a [positive](/Traits.aspx?ID=128) spell to damage undead, use [Command Undead](/Feats.aspx?ID=277), touch or damage an undead creature, or attack any creature while warded in this manner, the pendant's effects immediately end. An undead creature who observes you in this manner or one who succeeds at the Will save is immune to the _corpseward pendant_ for 24 hours.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
